Atal Pension Yojana.description: Pension scheme for citizens in the unorganized sector, providing a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 per month after 60 years of age.

documents: Aadhaar Card OR Voter ID OR Driving License
PM Jan Dhan Yojana.description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services, namely, basic savings & deposit accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, pension in an affordable manner.

documents: Savings Bank Account details with auto-debit consent
PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana.description: One-year life insurance scheme renewable from year to year, offering coverage for death due to any reason.

documents: Savings Bank Account details with auto-debit consent
PM Suraksha Bima Yojana.description: One-year accidental insurance scheme renewable from year to year, offering coverage for accidental death and disability.

documents: Passport size photographs of child and parent
Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana.description: Small deposit scheme for the girl child, launched as part of the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign.

documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar, Voter ID, PAN, Passport)
Business ID and Address Proof (licenses, registration certificates)
Quotations for machinery/equipment to be purchased
Passport size photographs of the applicant/partners
Mudra Loan.description: Loans up to Rs. 10 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
